name: Red Right Hand
description: The Red Right Hand hybrid: a minor drone (i, iv) plus a functional dominant that sidesteps down through a dorian major-IV7 back to the tonic instead of resolving straight home. In B minor this is Bm Em F#7 E7. Richer than the pure aeolian drones: it borrows a leading-tone V7 and a raised-6 IV7 at once.
source: Nick Cave & the Bad Seeds, Red Right Hand (Let Love In), chords provided by user
